meta.title: School round
meta.description: Record your judging panel, pick your shortlist for FOA and finalise your school round.

schoolRound.title: School round
schoolRound.lead: Judge your students’ entries against FOA’s rubric, record who judged, pick your shortlist for FOA and finalise.
schoolRound.limits: Per category you can shortlist up to {shortlist, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} and declare up to {positions, plural, =0 {no school positions} one {# school position} other {# school positions}}.

panel.title: Judging panel
panel.lead: Who judged your entries: up to {max} people, with their role. No contact details.

shortlist.title: Shortlist
shortlist.empty: None of your students submitted an entry, so there is nothing to shortlist. You can still finalise.
shortlist.pickedCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing picked} one {# picked} other {# picked}} of up to {limit}
shortlist.positionOption: {n, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}} place
shortlist.notSubmitted: Can’t be shortlisted: this entry never reached “submitted”.
shortlist.placed: {n, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}} place

finalise.title: Finalise
finalise.lead: Finalising makes your shortlist official. Shortlisted entries go to FOA for judging; every family is told the outcome. After this you can’t change the panel or the shortlist.
finalise.picks: Every shortlisted entry is still submitted
finalise.summary: {shortlisted, plural, =0 {No entry will be shortlisted} one {# entry will be shortlisted and sent to FOA} other {# entries will be shortlisted and sent to FOA}}; {others, plural, =0 {no other entry} one {# other entry} other {# other entries}} will be marked not shortlisted.
finalise.statement: I confirm that our judging panel judged every entry of {institution} in {competition} fairly, against FOA’s rubric, and that this shortlist and these school positions are the panel’s decision.
finalise.finalisedByFormer: Finalised on {date} by a coordinator who no longer has an account.
finalise.shortlistOnly: This competition takes digital work only from your shortlist. Finalising for it comes in a later update.
finalise.shortlistOnlyLead: Finalising makes your shortlist official. Entries go to FOA as soon as their uploads pass checks; every family is told the outcome. After this you can’t add students or change the panel or positions.
finalise.shortlistOnlyPicks: Every shortlisted entry belongs to the round
finalise.shortlistOnlySummary: {shortlisted, plural, =0 {No student has been shortlisted} one {# student is shortlisted} other {# students are shortlisted}}. {others, plural, =0 {No other family} one {# other family} other {# other families}} will be told their student was not shortlisted.

result.title: Your shortlist
result.notShortlisted: Not shortlisted: {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}}.
result.notShortlistedStudents: Not shortlisted: {count, plural, one {# student} other {# students}}.
result.closed: FOA closed this round on your school’s behalf on {date}. Reason: {reason}

outcome.finalised: Your school round is finalised. Families are being told the outcome.
outcome.panel_empty: Add at least one panel member.
outcome.panel_too_large: A panel can have at most 10 members.
outcome.invalid_input: Check the names and roles: each needs 1 to 120 characters.
outcome.shortlist_invalid: The shortlist wasn’t saved. Fix the problems below and save again.
outcome.unknown_category: That category has no entries in your round.
outcome.finalise_blocked: The round wasn’t finalised. Finish the steps in the checklist and tick the statement.
outcome.shortlist_only: Create each shortlisted entry from the student list instead.
outcome.round_not_editable: This round can’t be changed any more.
outcome.forbidden: You no longer act for this institution.
outcome.failed: Something went wrong and nothing was saved. Try again.

problem.unknown_entry: One picked entry isn’t in your round.
problem.not_submitted: {code} never reached “submitted”, so it can’t be shortlisted.
problem.position_taken: {code}: another entry already holds that position.

notOpen.title: Your school round isn’t open
notOpen.body: It opens when the competition moves to school judging, after submissions close, for registrations with at least one confirmed student.

notFound.title: We couldn’t find that registration
notFound.body: It may belong to another institution, or the link may be wrong.

shortlistOnly.title: Create shortlisted entries
shortlistOnly.lead: Judge the physical work at school. Upload a clear, high-resolution photo or scan (or the discipline’s digital file) only for students selected for FOA judging. Keep the physical work with the school or student.
shortlistOnly.photoHint: Use a high-resolution photo or scan showing the full work clearly.

declaration.original_work: This is the student’s own work, made for this competition.
declaration.faithful_reproduction: The upload faithfully shows the work as judged at school.
declaration.participation_covered: Our institution’s participation declaration covers this student taking part and being judged.
declaration.physical_work_kept: The physical work stays with the school or student until FOA requests it.

upload.checking: The upload is being checked. It will go to FOA once the round is finalised and checks pass.
upload.rejected: The upload was rejected. Please upload safe work again.
upload.failed: The upload couldn’t be processed. Please upload it again.

errors.not_shortlist_only: This competition takes submissions from all participants.
errors.not_open: The school round is not open yet.
errors.round_not_editable: The school round is no longer editable.
errors.student_not_found: This student doesn’t belong to the registration.
errors.registration_not_confirmed: The student’s registration must be confirmed.
errors.entry_locked: This entry has already moved on from the school round.
errors.discipline_not_offered: Choose a discipline offered to this student.
errors.wrong_type: Choose a file in one of the accepted formats.
errors.upload_limit: You have reached the pending upload limit. Try again shortly.
errors.shortlist_invalid: Check the category’s shortlist and positions.
errors.shortlist_full: This category has reached its shortlist limit.
errors.position_out_of_range: Choose a school position within the allowed range.
errors.position_taken: This position is already held by another entry in the category.
errors.file_not_found: The upload expired or was not found. Try again.
errors.upload_missing: The file didn’t reach storage. Try again.
errors.upload_rejected: The file did not match its declaration. Try a different file.
errors.invalid_input: Check the entry details and declarations.
errors.forbidden: You no longer act for this institution.
errors.storage_unavailable: File storage is unavailable. Try again later.

schoolRound.overdueNotice: The shortlist deadline has passed. Your round is overdue, but you can still make changes and finalise it.

manager.title: School rounds
manager.lead: Track school shortlists, close overdue rounds on a school’s behalf, or reopen a round during school judging before FOA verifies an entry.
manager.empty: No school rounds have opened yet.
manager.closeLead: This applies the saved shortlist and marks all other entries not shortlisted, even if the school did not certify its judging.
manager.reopenLead: This makes the shortlist a draft again and reverts entry outcomes. Only rounds without FOA-verified entries can be reopened during school judging.

outcome.closed: School round closed on the school’s behalf.
outcome.not_found: That school round was not found.
outcome.competition_not_judging: This competition is not in judging.
outcome.round_not_overdue: Only overdue rounds can be closed on a school’s behalf.
outcome.shortlist_only: This round cannot be closed yet.
outcome.finalise_blocked: The saved shortlist is no longer valid.
outcome.reopen_blocked: The round cannot be reopened. The competition must be in school judging, the round finished and no entry can have reached FOA verification.
outcome.forbidden: You do not manage this competition.
